said.details:
How The Estimate Is Worked Out: Each estimate is your recent work judged again as you are now, with the hours of practice added: what that would be worth a piece, in points of the whole, the latest piece counting most. For composure, 9 of your last 12 pieces call on it; A Doll’s House would gain most, about +0.8. About 0.8 of its estimate comes from the discipline 20 days of practice build, which any exercise kept up daily would bring too. Set Focus to Steady to start. Spaced pays more once your last session is a day to a week old. It’s an estimate: it reads only the work on your record, and the work you do next may call on different things.
What It Assumes Of Your Work: What the forecast assumes of your last 12 pieces: 11 were fully prepared, and 1 was underprepared and is counted as it was. None of them depends on knowing a genre.
Preparation Or Training: Both training and preparation are worth your time now, training more: 20 hours of composure would add about 1.36 a piece, and coming to your recent work fully prepared would have added about 0.80 a piece as you are now (0.80 from each piece’s own preparation, 0.00 from knowing its genre in full).
From Your Record: What held your last piece back most was discipline, but it isn’t what pays most to train now: it would pay less to train than composure. Composure is called on by more of your recent work, or has more room to grow.
Other Things Worth Your Time: Imagination, The Given Circumstances at the Developing tier: an estimated 1.1 points a piece for 20 hours, from 62 to about 65.
